design_correction: Attempt01 final diagnostics revealed fragmentation and lost MP3 types. Preserve attempt01, amend hard gates before independent new bounded run; not an undisclosed extension. Same baseline ranking/objective; new fixed seeds and2000 proposals each.
purpose: Distribution-focused descriptive refinement, not unbiased sampling or globally optimal search; no model or training

objective.relation_TV: Total variation of the 10 undirected relation family edge proportions.
objective.typed_logdegree_CDF: Mean normalized 1D Wasserstein/CDF-L1 distance across all positive-reference type x relation degree cells. Per cell integrate empirical CDF difference over log(1+degree), divide by fixed log(1+maximum reference degree in that cell). Actual raw graph degrees are unchanged. Exact discrete support integration, not histogram binning. Reference max is a fixed integration scale, not a matching target.
objective.clustering_abs_error: Absolute difference of mean local clustering (degree<2 gives zero), all nodes equally weighted.
objective.typed_triangle_TV: TV of normalized counts of all 20 unordered node-type triples.
objective.MP2_TV: TV of exact typed simple undirected length-2 path composition; reversal identified, original audited convention.
objective.missing_positive_triangle_fraction: Missing positive-reference triangle types divided by number of positive-reference triangle types. This macro penalty supplements count-weighted triangle TV.
objective.MP3: Composition distance not optimized. Preserve all baseline-positive exact MP3 types as hard gate; exact counts/TV remain final diagnostic.

baseline_selection: Score all three original candidates uniformly. Choose lowest objective among hard-valid candidates; ties lexicographic seed. IMDB additionally requires both reference-positive triangle types (including AAM).
hard_gates: Exactly192 unique original node IDs and exact fixed type quotas
Exact induced edges/relations/schema inherited unchanged from original, no edge editing
Every original active relation family remains positive
No loss of any triangle type represented in selected baseline; once a missing type is acquired it may not be lost
No loss of any MP2 type represented in selected baseline
LCC size at least selected baseline and number of components at most selected baseline
No loss of any MP3 type represented in selected baseline
proposal: At each of exactly2000 iterations choose node type uniformly; remove uniform selected node of that type; choose replacement uniformly from outside-selected same-type frontier with >=1 current selected neighbor with probability0.9, otherwise uniformly from all outside-selected same-type nodes. If frontier empty use full outside set. Reject invalid swaps, accept strictly improving objective by >1e-12; no extra restarts or budget extension.
constraints_note: 192-node induced subgraph necessarily truncates external edges. Per-type quotas further bound available neighbor degrees. Absolute degree tails and raw triangle/path counts cannot be expected to match full graph; no degree rescaling in saved graphs.
